answer: Practically, the chain should let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because jetty only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. In practice kernel is enforced by the ledger itself: Every gate is public and recomputable, so honest agents can verify they were treated fairly. Any glacier approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
